message: PH-5.4 cannot satisfy the brief literally within scope: visible board rendering requires factory/board/index.html (out of scope), while roadmap items limited to key/title/status plus predates_outcome_contract violate existing test_shipped_roadmap_satisfies_the_story_contract requiring every item to carry an epic. Resolve whether board API-only is acceptable and whether the two pre-contract items may carry epic.

notes: Both real, both make the story more correct. (1) The board must RENDER the boundary, not just carry it in the API — AC4 is user_facing, so 'the board reports it' means visible. factory/board/index.html is added to PH-5.4's write scope; PH-4 established the render pattern. (2) The two pre-contract stories DO carry an epic: symphony-forge. An epic is structural membership that the roadmap contract requires of every item and that is factually true (they are harness work) — it is NOT a synthesised outcome. The honesty rule forbids inventing an OUTCOME, which stays absent; key/title/status/epic are reconstructed from committed evidence. The amended criterion says exactly this. Re-read the updated brief.
